theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f h
  have h₁ : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
    intro i
    have h₂ : 7 ∣ digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then e j else d j) := (hrelation d e).mp h.1 |>.2 i
    have h₃ : digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then e j else d j) = digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
      calc
        digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then e j else d j) = ∑ j, (if j = i then e j else d j) * 10 ^ j.1 := by rw [hdigits_to_num]
        _ = ∑ j, (d j + (if j = i then e j - d j else 0)) * 10 ^ j.1 := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j _
          by_cases h₄ : j = i
          · simp [h₄]
          · simp [h₄]
        _ = ∑ j, (d j * 10 ^ j.1 + (if j = i then e j - d j else 0) * 10 ^ j.1) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j _
          ring
        _ = ∑ j, d j * 10 ^ j.1 + ∑ j, (if j = i then e j - d j else 0) * 10 ^ j.1 := by rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        _ = digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
          simp [hdigits_to_num, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ]
    rw [h₃] at h₂
    exact h₂
  have h₂ : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
    intro i
    have h₃ : 7 ∣ digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then f j else e j) := (hrelation e f).mp h.2 |>.2 i
    have h₄ : digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then f j else e j) = digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
      calc
        digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then f j else e j) = ∑ j, (if j = i then f j else e j) * 10 ^ j.1 := by rw [hdigits_to_num]
        _ = ∑ j, (e j + (if j = i then f j - e j else 0)) * 10 ^ j.1 := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j _
          by_cases h₅ : j = i
          · simp [h₅]
          · simp [h₅]
        _ = ∑ j, (e j * 10 ^ j.1 + (if j = i then f j - e j else 0) * 10 ^ j.1) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j _
          ring
        _ = ∑ j, e j * 10 ^ j.1 + ∑ j, (if j = i then f j - e j else 0) * 10 ^ j.1 := by rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        _ = digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
          simp [hdigits_to_num, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ]
    rw [h₄] at h₃
    exact h₃
  have h₃ : 7 ∣ digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e := by
    have h₄ : 7 ∣ ∑ i, (digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1) := Finset.dvd_sum (fun i _ => h₁ i)
    have h₅ : ∑ i, (digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1) = 9 * digits_to_num d + (digits_to_num e - digits_to_num d) := by
      calc
        ∑ i, (digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1) = ∑ i, digits_to_num d + ∑ i, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        _ = 9 * digits_to_num d + ∑ i, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by simp [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
        _ = 9 * digits_to_num d + ∑ i, (e i * 10 ^ i.1 - d i * 10 ^ i.1) := by
          congr
          ext i
          ring
        _ = 9 * digits_to_num d + (∑ i, e i * 10 ^ i.1 - ∑ i, d i * 10 ^ i.1) := by rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        _ = 9 * digits_to_num d + (digits_to_num e - digits_to_num d) := by simp [hdigits_to_num]
    rw [h₅] at h₄
    have h₆ : 9 * digits_to_num d + (digits_to_num e - digits_to_num d) = 8 * digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e := by ring
    rw [h₆] at h₄
    have h₇ : 8 * digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e = 7 * digits_to_num d + (digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e) := by ring
    rw [h₇] at h₄
    exact dvd_add_right h₄
  have h₄ : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (f i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
    intro i
    have h₅ : 7 ∣ (digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * 10 ^ i.1) + (digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1) := by
      exact dvd_add (h₂ i) (h₁ i)
    have h₆ : (digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * 10 ^ i.1) + (digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1) = (digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d) + (f i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by ring
    rw [h₆] at h₅
    exact dvd_add_right h₅
  intro i
  have h₅ : 7 ∣ (f i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 := h₄ i
  have h₆ : ¬(7 : ℤ) ∣ (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
    intro h
    have h₇ : (7 : ℕ) ∣ (10 : ℕ) ^ i.1 := by norm_cast at h
    have h₈ : (7 : ℕ) ∣ 10 := by
      apply Nat.Prime.dvd_of_dvd_pow (by decide) h₇
    norm_num at h₈
  have h₇ : (7 : ℤ) ∣ (f i - d i) ∨ (7 : ℤ) ∣ (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
    apply (Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.mpr (by decide)).dvd_mul.mp
    exact h₅
  cases h₇ with
  | inl h₇ => exact h₇
  | inr h₇ => exfalso; exact h₆ h₇
